acceptance.help: Write the product's acceptance document as Markdown, read off its own .feature files.

docs.help: Write the command reference, then build the website from it.

image.help: Build the product's container image from its declared Dockerfile, with VERSION/REVISION, for every declared platform.

reference.help: Write the product's command reference as Markdown, read off its BUILT command line.

site.help: Build the product's documentation website with Hugo, in Docker (HTML only).

image.help: Push the product's container image and verify the tag, and every declared platform, is in the registry.

tag.help: Cut the release tag at HEAD and push it (`git push origin <tag>`, never `--tags`).

ci-arm64.help: Check that THIS host can build linux/arm64, and register the emulator if not (VM or LXC; needs root).

ci-disk-cleanup.help: Prune build cache older than a day - the step a job runs when it is done, whatever it decided.

ci-disk-hygiene.help: Cap docker logs, bound the build cache and install a daily prune on THIS host (needs root).

ci-disk-preflight.help: Refuse to start a job on a runner whose docker disk is too full to finish one.

ci-privileges.help: Give a user passwordless sudo and the docker group on THIS host (needs root; idempotent).

claude-plugins.help: Install the Claude Code plugins declared in the manifest's `claude` section; idempotent.

completion.help: Regenerate the product's shell completion from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

doctor.help: Check the tools and the environment.

install.help: Provision the host tooling the kernel needs - today oras; idempotent.

workflows.help: Regenerate the product's GitHub workflows from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

auth-scopes.help: Grant the stored gh token the package scopes GHCR needs (interactive, idempotent).

prune-branches.help: Delete local branches already merged into main (squash-aware via gh).

submodules.help: git submodule update --init lib/platform (init the submodule a fresh worktree needs).

catalogue.help: List the task coordinates the delivery kernel offers, marking the namespaces this product's commands reach.

generate.help: Regenerate the product's CLI module from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

all.help: Run every test: the pytest suite, the type gate, the staleness gate, then the release-notes guard.

generated.help: Fail if a committed generated file is not what its own command produces.

release-notes.help: Check the product's releases page against the tags and merges its repository carries.

report.help: Merge the unit results into the shared Allure results and render the HTML archive.

typecheck-python.help: Type-check the product's Python sources with mypy, in the host venv (no Docker, no lab).

walk.help: Walk the product's acceptance scenarios with a person answering each step.
